# Come Get This Junk

> Fast, friendly junk removal in the San Fernando Valley and Los Angeles. Text a photo for an upfront price; same-day or next-day haul-away.

Julian Hardee Services operates as Come Get This Junk. Primary contact: SMS or call 747-319-6969.

## Pages

- [Home — junk removal in the San Fernando Valley](https://comegetthisjunk.com/): Services, pricing flow, service promise, FAQ, and areas served.
- [Woodland Hills junk removal](https://comegetthisjunk.com/woodland-hills/): Hillside homes and Warner Center condos.
- [Tarzana junk removal](https://comegetthisjunk.com/tarzana/): Ranch-house garages, Ventura corridor, hillside access.
- [Reseda junk removal](https://comegetthisjunk.com/reseda/): Houses and apartment move-outs off Sherman Way and Reseda Boulevard.
- [Encino junk removal](https://comegetthisjunk.com/encino/): Ventura Boulevard condos and hillside houses south of the boulevard.
- [Sherman Oaks junk removal](https://comegetthisjunk.com/sherman-oaks/): Hillside houses south of Ventura and apartment jobs to the north.

## Services

- [Estate cleanout](https://comegetthisjunk.com/estate-cleanout/): Whole-house clearing from photos; metal recycled, valuables set aside, donation, proper disposal.
- [Garage cleanout](https://comegetthisjunk.com/garage-cleanout/): Garages packed to the ceiling, priced from a photo.
- [Hot tub removal](https://comegetthisjunk.com/hot-tub-removal/): Hot tubs and spas taken apart and hauled.
- [Furniture and mattress removal](https://comegetthisjunk.com/furniture-removal/): Couches, mattresses, bed frames, and dressers.
- [Move-out and apartment cleanout](https://comegetthisjunk.com/move-out-cleanout/): Deadline-driven unit and apartment clearing.
- [Appliance removal](https://comegetthisjunk.com/appliance-removal/): Refrigerators, washers, dryers, stoves, dishwashers.
- [Exercise equipment removal](https://comegetthisjunk.com/exercise-equipment-removal/): Treadmills, ellipticals, benches, and home gyms.
- [Office furniture removal](https://comegetthisjunk.com/office-furniture-removal/): Desks, file cabinets, cubicles, and old electronics.
- [Storage unit cleanout](https://comegetthisjunk.com/storage-unit-cleanout/): Units emptied and sorted; gates handled.
- [Fence, patio and pool tear-out](https://comegetthisjunk.com/fence-patio-pool-tear-out/): Fences, patio covers, decks, sheds, and pool equipment.

## For professionals

- [Realtors](https://comegetthisjunk.com/realtors/): Pre-listing cleanouts before photos or a showing.
- [Property managers and landlords](https://comegetthisjunk.com/property-managers/): Unit turnovers; recurring service and invoicing by request.
- [Contractors and remodelers](https://comegetthisjunk.com/contractors/): Remodel and construction debris; fully licensed.
- [Estate attorneys and senior move managers](https://comegetthisjunk.com/estate-professionals/): Referral-friendly estate cleanouts.

## Pricing and limits

- [How junk removal is priced](https://comegetthisjunk.com/junk-removal-cost/): Price is set by distance, rush, and weight and complexity; quoted from a photo, no rate card.
- [What we can't take](https://comegetthisjunk.com/what-we-dont-take/): Paint, solvents, pesticides, propane tanks, batteries, tires, asbestos or lead material, medical waste, ammunition.

## How to hire

1. Text a photo of the junk pile to 747-319-6969.
2. Receive an upfront price (large or complex jobs may need an in-person look the same day).
3. Schedule haul-away — usually same day or next day.

## What we take

Furniture, yard cleanup, small demo, and apartment, garage, and estate cleanouts.

## Service area

Woodland Hills, Tarzana, Reseda, Encino, Sherman Oaks, and surrounding San Fernando Valley neighborhoods.
